scenarios.title: Isolated multi-session burst and memory plateau
covers: defined session count and deterministic output rate
burst shape with warm-up and foreground/background phases
observational GC policy with forced GC in owned workload children
host, cgroup, target-tree, child-process RSS, swap, and memory PSI
RSS plateau across two cache-churn cycles
oversized Unicode and ANSI output generation

scenarios.title: Many subscribers share one targeted seed capture
scenarios.activation: Activate when the integration fixture can expose the seed-capture counter while attaching deterministic Socket.IO clients to one scratch application session.
expected: all subscribers converge on the same final terminal state

scenarios.title: Reconnect while requested sequence remains in replay ring
scenarios.activation: Activate with the scratch application-session fixture; reconnect with a retained lastSequence and assert replay without a fresh seed.

scenarios.title: Reconnect older than replay ring forces reseed
scenarios.activation: Activate when the bounded replay ring and explicit forced-reseed response are available.

scenarios.title: Mobile viewport advances with zero web subscribers
scenarios.activation: Activate when the harness has an authenticated bridge/mobile viewport fixture for a scratch session.

scenarios.title: One stalled socket does not delay a current socket
scenarios.activation: Activate with the application-owned per-socket queue and writable-transport control surface.
expected: stalled socket is bounded or disconnected

scenarios.title: Oversized Unicode and ANSI chunks preserve terminal state
scenarios.activation: Activate when a scratch application session can route the active host-burst generator through Socket.IO into headless xterm.

scenarios.title: Seed during burst converges after resync completion
scenarios.activation: Activate when the resync_complete protocol exists; include output emitted between capture and resync completion.
expected: headless xterm equals fresh tmux capture

scenarios.title: Stopped, crashed, and dead sessions clean up identically
scenarios.activation: Activate with disposable application storage and scratch session lifecycle controls.

scenarios.title: Summary and full transcript parity for every provider
scenarios.activation: Activate when deterministic transcript fixtures for every registered provider can be loaded into disposable storage.

scenarios.title: Eviction remains correct during summary, index, and chunk reads
scenarios.activation: Activate when bounded transcript caches and deterministic eviction controls are available.

scenarios.title: Engine.IO writeBuffer does not grow while transport is unwritable
scenarios.activation: Activate with the application-owned queue and an unwritable-transport test seam.
